Hi Marta —

Thanks again for committing to Redwood Dedicated. To keep things aligned with the margin targets you shared, I put together an initial rightsize workbook and a proposed cutover cadence so engineering can validate performance without surprising your procurement team. Attached: RightSize_v2.xlsx (high-level utilization and cost model).

Key asks from us to you this week:
- Confirm the expected 95th-pct concurrent RPS on peak hour (you mentioned ~750 RPS in last call).
- Confirm model variant(s) you plan to run in production (you previously indicated \"gpt-embed-lite\" and Llama2-70B-INT8 for generation).

High-level plan (proposal):
1) Validation window (staging): 48h soak at 1.25x peak, run the acceptance matrix (attached)
2) Day-of swap: 2-hour pre-cutover smoke, 60-minute traffic ramp, 1-hour steady-state validation; 1-hour rollback window if any regression
3) Post-swap: 72h monitoring with rooftop SLIs and cost scarlet alerts

I'll loop in Karthik and Ben on sizing details. If this looks okay, can you confirm the proposed week of Aug 23 for staging? Once you confirm we will drop a DocuSign for the commitment and schedule the Commissioning ticket.

Thanks —

Thanks for the numbers — below is a pragmatic sizing and timeline that balances cost and margin. Attaching a quick CSV with per-GPU throughput baselines.

Sizing summary (assumptions):
- Model: Llama2-70B-INT8 running with Redwood runtime optimizations (continuous batching, KV caching)
- Typical token/sec (64 token seq test): ~1,400 tokens/sec per A100-80GB equiv for generation paths in our bench; embeddings on V100-class are ignored here
- Effective concurrency target (95th): 820 RPS with median response length ~350 tokens -> ~287k tokens/sec aggregate -> baseline ~205 token/sec? (note: we'll run throughput benchmarks in staging)

Our recommendation: start with a 10-GPU committed pool (A100-class equiv, 80GB), which gives us runway and headroom for 1.25x peak via autoscaling policy. This is conservative for margin and keeps per-token cost reasonable when combined with prefix/KV caching. If we enable INT8 quant paths for the generation variant we should see ~1.6x token/sec improvement per GPU.

Acceptance & validation criteria (staging):
- Latency: p95 <= 220ms for priority routes under 1.25x peak load
- Success rate >= 99.5% (no 5xxs for inference requests)
- KV cache warm-hit >= 70% within 30 minutes of steady traffic profile
- Memory & GPU utilization: steady-state GPU mem < 75% to avoid OOM risk during peaks
- 48-hour soak with three synthetic traffic patterns (burst, steady, long-tail)

Cutover cadence (proposed):
- Day -7: Commissioning ticket opens, reserve GPUs, pre-load model artifacts to staging nodes
- Day -1: Staging start, run smoke and short soak (4h)
- Day 0 (swap window): 02:00–05:00 PT reserved for production swap; pre-cutover smoke, 60m ramp, steady-state validation 60m, rollback 60m
- Day +1 to +3: Elevated monitoring and automated rollback guardrails

Rollback plan snippet: if p95 degrades > 15% vs baseline or error-rate > 0.5% in any 15m window, trigger automatic traffic shift back to hosted pool and create incident.

We can provide SOC2 attestation and a staging audit-log export; Monica, can you attach the standard extract to the commissioning ticket?

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Staff, Inference Engineering
